definitions.explanation: addressing the root cause of a problem rather than just the symptoms; fundamental reform or change

examples.japanese: ⟦{抜本的|ばっぽんてき}→抜本的：12898_bapponteki⟧な⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜本的|ばっぽんてき}→抜本的：12898_bapponteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To solve the problem radically/at its root.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抜本的|ばっぽんてき}→抜本的：12898_bapponteki⟧な⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: A fundamental review of the system is being called for.

notes:
{抜本|ばっぽん} means addressing something at its root or fundamentally.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {抜|ばつ}: To pull out, extract
- {本|ぽん}: Root, origin

Literal meaning: "pulling out the root" - addressing the fundamental cause.

MOST COMMON FORM:
Usually appears as ⟦{抜本的|ばっぽんてき}→抜本的：12898_bapponteki⟧ (na-adjective form).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{抜本的|ばっぽんてき}→抜本的：12898_bapponteki⟧な⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧ (fundamental reform)
- ⟦{抜本的|ばっぽんてき}→抜本的：12898_bapponteki⟧な⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (drastic measures)
- ⟦{抜本的|ばっぽんてき}→抜本的：12898_bapponteki⟧な⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧ (fundamental review)
- ⟦{抜本的|ばっぽんてき}→抜本的：12898_bapponteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧ (to solve radically)
- ⟦{抜本的|ばっぽんてき}→抜本的：12898_bapponteki⟧な⟦{変革|へんかく}→変革：12100_henkaku⟧ (fundamental transformation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抜本的|ばっぽんてき}→抜本的：12898_bapponteki⟧ (fundamental - addresses root cause)
- {対症|たいしょう}⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (symptomatic - only addresses symptoms)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{根本的|こんぽんてき}→根本的：17920_konponteki⟧ (fundamental - similar meaning)
- {抜本塞源|ばっぽんそくげん} (to uproot completely - idiom)

REGISTER: Formal. Common in news, politics, and business contexts.
